_blocked_note: Never surface these companies anywhere — discovery, scoring, referral, networking. Matched on normalized company name.
_manual_targets_note: Pre-qualified networking slots from research. Most are not on Greenhouse, so networking_daily gives them a slot without a board signal. Selection criteria beyond adtech: any company whose core problem is supply-demand matching, auctions/pricing, conversion economics, attribution, or ops enablement — marketplaces, CTV platforms, fintech with marketplace dynamics all qualify (e.g. the LawnStarter/Roku/Tereina shapes), not just ad platforms.
